headline: Updated policies on employee computer monitoring, reference checks, bloodborne pathogens, and student restraint were reviewed.
summary: Four policies were updated to follow new state laws and guidance. The computer use policy now requires notice of electronic monitoring for employees hired on or after October 1. Parents must now be told the same day a student is placed in physical restraint or seclusion.
discussion: Computer use policy scope: Staff confirmed that a teacher using a personal phone on school Wi-Fi would technically fall under the policy. Speakers said the policy does not separate personal phones from school devices.
Out-of-state applicant checks: Speakers favored adding optional language on out-of-state registry checks. They asked that the full board see it and have it explained before deciding.
Bloodborne pathogen rules: Speakers asked whether the policy should say that schools are now a high-hazard industry. Staff said it need not say that, and that all staff take yearly exposure training.
